verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair privacy question for a payroll and HR SaaS platform, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents user-facing retention settings, deletion workflows, or deletion APIs. The pack covers business formation, banking, the MCP server, the CLI, SDKs, webhooks, the OpenAPI spec and reports, none of which address this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
